lines.zh: 皇族在廊道里踱步，翅膀收得极紧
lines.en: The royal paces the gallery, wings folded tight.

lines.zh: 两对翅膀擦着石壁，发出沙沙声
lines.en: Two pairs of wings rasp the stone with a dry whisper.

lines.zh: 她走得很稳，像随时准备起飞
lines.en: She walks steadily, as if ready to take off.

lines.zh: 翅鞘下的肌肉一鼓一缩
lines.en: The muscles beneath her wing cases flex and slacken.

lines.zh: 她在洞口来回走了第七趟
lines.en: She has walked the tunnel mouth seven times now.

lines.zh: 足尖沾着巢里的树脂，一路留下印
lines.en: Resin from the nest clings to her feet, trailing behind.

lines.zh: 皇族的步幅比工蚁长一半
lines.en: The royal's stride is half again a worker's.

lines.zh: 她走两步，停一下，听外面的风
lines.en: Two steps, a pause, listening to the wind outside.

lines.zh: 四翅半张，她在试风向
lines.en: Four wings half-open, she tests the wind.

lines.zh: 地道尽头，她仰头看那点天光
lines.en: At the tunnel's end, she tilts her head to the sliver of daylight.

lines.zh: 她绕开卵室，不愿惊动女皇
lines.en: She skirts the egg chamber, unwilling to disturb the queen.

lines.zh: 翅膜透光，映出洞壁的纹路
lines.en: Her wing membrane is translucent, showing the wall's veins.

lines.zh: 她走过的地方留着淡淡的蜡味
lines.en: A faint waxy scent lingers where she has walked.

lines.zh: 她的足在土上留下四道浅痕
lines.en: Her feet leave four shallow lines in the soil.

lines.zh: 她的触角先出洞口，探了探风。
lines.en: Her antennae leave the tunnel first, testing the wind

lines.zh: 皇族沿着巢壁走，翅尖刮着土。
lines.en: The royal walks the nest wall, wingtips scraping dirt

lines.zh: 她停在洞顶，翅膀一动不动
lines.en: She hangs from the ceiling, wings utterly still.

lines.zh: 皇族要等很久，才等到起飞的时辰
lines.en: The royal waits a long while for the hour of flight.

lines.zh: 她用后足梳理翅膜上的灰
lines.en: She grooms dust from her wing membrane with a hind leg.

lines.zh: 她把翅展开又合上，来回三次
lines.en: She spreads her wings and folds them, three times over.

lines.zh: 洞外有风，她的触角跟着动
lines.en: Wind moves outside; her antennae move with it.

lines.zh: 她不吃，只把口器润了润
lines.en: She does not eat, only moistens her mouthparts.

lines.zh: 翅膀底下藏着一层薄薄的绒毛
lines.en: A thin fuzz is hidden under her wings.

lines.zh: 她在心里量着到地面的距离
lines.en: She is measuring, in her head, the distance to the surface.

lines.zh: 皇族的身子比工蚁轻，骨架是空的
lines.en: The royal is lighter than a worker, her frame hollow.

lines.zh: 她靠墙歇着，翅尖轻轻抖
lines.en: She rests against the wall, wingtips trembling faintly.

lines.zh: 巢里的空气闷，她张开口器换气
lines.en: The nest air is stale; she opens her mouthparts to breathe.

lines.zh: 她在等一场雨停，好出去
lines.en: She waits for a rain to stop so she can leave.

lines.zh: 她偏头，四翅微微张开
lines.en: She tilts her head, four wings opening slightly.

lines.zh: 皇族第一次见你，先看你的手
lines.en: Meeting you for the first time, she looks at your hands first.

lines.zh: 她的复眼里，你被分成几千块
lines.en: In her compound eyes you are split into thousands of pieces.

lines.zh: 她打量你的姿势，像在判断能不能飞过
lines.en: She studies your stance, judging whether she can fly past.

lines.zh: 她把你当成洞口的障碍
lines.en: She files you as an obstacle at the tunnel mouth.

lines.zh: 翅尖对着你，随时可以离地
lines.en: Her wingtips point at you; she could lift off at any moment.

lines.zh: 她歪着头，听你的呼吸
lines.en: She cocks her head and listens to your breathing.

lines.zh: 她的触角扫过你的袖口
lines.en: Her antennae brush across your sleeve.

lines.zh: 皇族不怕你，她只怕被困住
lines.en: The royal does not fear you; she fears being caged.

lines.zh: 她在你身上闻到了地面的味道
lines.en: She smells the surface on you.

lines.zh: 她的翅膜破了一个口子
lines.en: A hole opens in her wing membrane.

lines.zh: 她尖叫了一声，声音很细
lines.en: She gives a thin, high cry.

lines.zh: 受伤后她先护翅，再护头
lines.en: Wounded, she shields her wings before her head.

lines.zh: 体液顺着翅根往下淌
lines.en: Hemolymph runs down from her wing roots.

lines.zh: 她落在地上，翻身很吃力
lines.en: She hits the ground and struggles to right herself.

lines.zh: 这一击让她飞得歪了
lines.en: The blow leaves her flying crooked.

lines.zh: 她的甲比工蚁薄，伤得更深
lines.en: Her shell is thinner than a worker's, so the wound runs deeper.

lines.zh: 她抖了抖翅，抖不干净
lines.en: She shakes her wings and cannot shake it off.

lines.zh: 痛让她放弃了一次起飞
lines.en: The pain costs her one takeoff.

lines.zh: 她退到角落，翅收成一条线
lines.en: She retreats to a corner, wings folded to a line.

lines.zh: 你手里的甜食，比不上外面的风
lines.en: The sweet in your hand is worth less than the wind outside.

lines.zh: 她闻了闻，翅却没有落下
lines.en: She sniffs it, but her wings do not lower.

lines.zh: 皇族只在起飞前吃一点点
lines.en: The royal eats only a little before flight.

lines.zh: 她把食物推开，让给旁边的工蚁
lines.en: She pushes the food aside for a nearby worker.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃果子，她的触角跟着转
lines.en: You wave the fruit; her antennae follow it.

lines.zh: 她舔了一口，又抬头看洞口
lines.en: She licks once, then looks back at the tunnel mouth.

lines.zh: 她更想要一块能晒翅膀的石头
lines.en: She would rather have a stone to sun her wings on.

lines.zh: 饥饿压不住她想飞的那股劲
lines.en: Hunger cannot outweigh her urge to fly.

lines.zh: 她接过食物，只用前足夹着
lines.en: She accepts the food, holding it with a foreleg.

lines.zh: 你给的越多，她越疑心
lines.en: The more you offer, the more suspicious she grows.

lines.zh: 她撞上你，翅膜发出脆响
lines.en: She collides with you, and her wing membrane crackles.

lines.zh: 她比你轻，却撞得你一晃
lines.en: She is lighter than you, yet the bump staggers you.

lines.zh: 四翅一撑，她从你肩上弹开
lines.en: Four wings brace, and she springs off your shoulder.

lines.zh: 她歪了半尺，随即稳住身形
lines.en: She lurches half a foot, then rights herself.

lines.zh: 你碰到她的翅根，她猛地转身
lines.en: You touch a wing root, and she whirls around.

lines.zh: 她撞在你胸口，爪尖先到
lines.en: She hits your chest, claws first.

lines.zh: 皇族的身子一碰就退，退得极快
lines.en: The royal yields at a touch, and yields fast.

lines.zh: 她的翅扫过你的脸，带着灰
lines.en: Her wing sweeps your face, trailing dust.

lines.zh: 她落在地上，先护住翅膀
lines.en: She lands and shields her wings first.

lines.zh: 你挡了路，她贴着墙绕过去
lines.en: You block the way; she slips past along the wall.

lines.zh: 她终于起飞，去找另一座巢的雄蚁
lines.en: She takes flight at last, seeking a male from another nest.

lines.zh: 交配之后，雄蚁不会活着回来
lines.en: After mating, the male does not return alive.

lines.zh: 她要把新的蚁穴建在别处
lines.en: She will found her new nest somewhere else.

lines.zh: 翅下的气味会引来同类
lines.en: The scent beneath her wings will draw her own kind.

lines.zh: 她绕圈飞了三遭，才落在枝上
lines.en: She circles three times before settling on a branch.

lines.zh: 这一场飞行，赌的是整座新巢
lines.en: This one flight wagers an entire new nest.

lines.zh: 她收起翅膀，等对方先靠近
lines.en: She folds her wings and waits for the other to approach.

lines.zh: 从此她不再是皇族，而是女皇
lines.en: From then on she is no royal, but a queen.

lines.zh: 她会带着足够的精子，独自挖第一条隧道
lines.en: She will carry enough seed and dig the first tunnel alone.

lines.zh: 巢的选址，她早已在心里定了
lines.en: She settled the site of her nest long ago.

lines.zh: 她叼起一片干叶，掂了掂
lines.en: She picks up a dry leaf and weighs it.

lines.zh: 皇族只带轻的东西上路
lines.en: A royal travels light.

lines.zh: 她把石子推开，嫌它碍事
lines.en: She shoves the pebble aside; it offends her.

lines.zh: 她捡起一根细枝，用来试风向
lines.en: She picks up a twig to test the wind.

lines.zh: 东西太重，她拖了两下就放下
lines.en: Too heavy; she drags it twice and lets go.

lines.zh: 她把树脂抹在翅根上
lines.en: She smears resin at the base of her wings.

lines.zh: 她的颚很细，只夹得住轻物
lines.en: Her mandibles are slender, good only for light things.

lines.zh: 她叼着东西，仍不肯收翅
lines.en: She carries it in her jaws and still will not fold her wings.

lines.zh: 掉落的东西，她先用触角碰一下
lines.en: She touches dropped things with an antenna first.

lines.zh: 她只带走能塞进新巢的东西
lines.en: She takes only what will fit in a new nest.

lines.zh: 她的翅膀忽然立起，转向你
lines.en: Her wings snap upright; she turns toward you.

lines.zh: 你挡住了起飞的路，她记下了
lines.en: You block her takeoff; she notes it.

lines.zh: 她绕着你走了半圈，找空隙
lines.en: She circles you halfway, looking for a gap.

lines.zh: 皇族也会咬人，尤其被逼到墙角
lines.en: Royals bite too, especially when cornered.

lines.zh: 她判定你是威胁，翅根绷紧
lines.en: She marks you a threat; her wing roots tense.

lines.zh: 她不再看洞口，只看你
lines.en: She stops watching the exit and watches you.

lines.zh: 触角压低，她开始算距离
lines.en: Her antennae lower; she starts gauging distance.

lines.zh: 她把你归为必须清掉的障碍
lines.en: She classes you as an obstacle to clear away.

lines.zh: 起飞失败，她改用颚
lines.en: Takeoff is spoiled; she falls back on her jaws.

lines.zh: 她退到洞壁，翅膀张开当盾
lines.en: She backs to the wall, wings spread as a shield.

lines.zh: 她发出一串短促的咔哒声
lines.en: She clicks out a short, rapid series.

lines.zh: 你正站在她的起飞路线中间
lines.en: You are standing dead center in her flight path.

lines.zh: 她贴地疾走，翅尖扫着土
lines.en: She races low, wingtips brushing the soil.

lines.zh: 她先飞起一半，又落回来
lines.en: She half-lifts off, then drops back down.

lines.zh: 每绕一圈，她就靠近一点
lines.en: Each circle brings her a little closer.

lines.zh: 复眼锁着你，翅膜在抖
lines.en: Her compound eyes lock on you; her wing membrane quivers.

lines.zh: 洞顶太低，她只好步行逼近
lines.en: The ceiling is too low; she advances on foot.

lines.zh: 她撞墙借力，折向你
lines.en: She bounces off the wall and angles at you.

lines.zh: 她的咔哒声越来越急
lines.en: Her clicking grows faster and faster.

lines.zh: 她试了两次起飞，都放弃了
lines.en: She tries to lift off twice, and gives it up.

lines.zh: 她把翅膀贴平，减少声音
lines.en: She flattens her wings to cut the noise.

lines.zh: 你的影子和她重叠，她扑了过来
lines.en: Your shadow merges with hers; she lunges.

lines.zh: 她沿着墙根绕到你侧后
lines.en: She works along the wall to your flank.

lines.zh: 她在等你先动
lines.en: She is waiting for you to move first.

lines.zh: 她先用颚咬，再用翅拍
lines.en: She bites first, then beats her wings.

lines.zh: 翅风扑面，你睁不开眼
lines.en: Wingwind hits your face; you cannot keep your eyes open.

lines.zh: 她的颚小而尖，专挑关节
lines.en: Her small sharp jaws go for your joints.

lines.zh: 一击不中，她立刻弹开
lines.en: She misses, and springs away at once.

lines.zh: 她扑到你背上，爪抓得很深
lines.en: She lands on your back, claws digging deep.

lines.zh: 翅膜扫过硬甲，声音刺耳
lines.en: Her wing membrane scrapes your plate, shrilly.

lines.zh: 她用尾端一戳，转身就退
lines.en: She jabs with her tail end, then retreats.

lines.zh: 她的攻击短促，像在试探
lines.en: Her strikes are short, like probes.

lines.zh: 她咬住你的袖口，把人往墙边拽
lines.en: She clamps your cuff and drags you toward the wall.

lines.zh: 你打出这一下，她掉了半片翅
lines.en: Your blow knocks half a wing off her.

lines.zh: 一只皇族从蛹里钻出，翅还是软的
lines.en: A royal crawls from its pupa, wings still soft.

lines.zh: 她把新翅摊在石上晾干
lines.en: She spreads her new wings on the stone to dry.

lines.zh: 四翅第一次展开，比身体还长
lines.en: Her four wings unfold for the first time, longer than her body.

lines.zh: 皇族出生就知道自己要走
lines.en: The royal knows from birth that she must leave.

lines.zh: 她的第一顿饭，是工蚁喂的蜜
lines.en: Her first meal is honey fed by a worker.

lines.zh: 翅根还是半透明的，像湿纸
lines.en: Her wing roots are translucent, like wet paper.

lines.zh: 她试飞了一次，只飞了两尺
lines.en: She tries a first flight and covers two feet.

lines.zh: 巢里的气味告诉她，她是皇族
lines.en: The nest's scent tells her she is a royal.

lines.zh: 她排在洞口，等轮到自己离开
lines.en: She queues at the tunnel mouth, waiting her turn to leave.

lines.zh: 新翅一硬，她就再没回过巢里
lines.en: Once her wings hardened, she never returned to the nest.

lines.zh: 火苗舔上翅膜，卷了个洞
lines.en: Flame licks her wing membrane, curling a hole in it.

lines.zh: 她摔在石上，翅先着地
lines.en: She falls on stone, wings taking the impact.

lines.zh: 水浸透绒毛，她飞不起来了
lines.en: Water soaks her fuzz; she can no longer fly.

lines.zh: 气浪把她掀到洞顶
lines.en: The blast throws her against the ceiling.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翅膜，留下一个圆孔
lines.en: The arrow pierces her wing, leaving a round hole.

lines.zh: 光刺穿她的复眼，视野碎了
lines.en: Light stabs her compound eye, shattering her sight.

lines.zh: 饿久了，翅膀垂成两片薄纸
lines.en: Starved too long, her wings hang like two thin sheets.

lines.zh: 雷光烧过翅脉，一路焦黑
lines.en: Lightning scorches along her wing veins, blackening them.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，她张翅也没用
lines.en: The void has no wind; her wings are useless there.
